paragraphs: TeamGenius sells player evaluation software that youth sports organizations use for tryouts, camps and player feedback. The product is presented as a replacement for paper forms, hours of data entry and spreadsheets at tryouts. Beyond tryouts, the platform covers mid or end of season player evaluations, branded feedback reports, and evaluation of coaches or referees.

Evaluation history is kept so organizations can track player development and get new coaches up to speed. Administrative work covered includes importing players from a registration platform and managing player check-in from a phone or tablet. Coaches get a mobile app for evaluating players, along with feedback reports and a database of player evaluation history.
Pricing starts with a free trial for 14 days and up to 20 players, and a demo can be requested. The company gives its headquarters as Edina, Minnesota.

quote.text: The App That Makes Player Evaluations Easy
